// diagnostic

E0116

Valueless call used as a value

What

Valueless call used as a value

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0116

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0116: tests/ui/bare_lambda_param_type_unknown.stderr.

Error [E0801]: tell me the type of `x`
  --> tests/ui/bare_lambda_param_type_unknown.jet:2:10
    |
  2 |     f :: x -> x + 1
    |          ^
 Why: this lambda parameter has no type to go on
 Fix: write `(x: Int) -> …` (or whatever type fits)
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0801

Error [E0116]: `f` doesn't hand back a value
  --> tests/ui/bare_lambda_param_type_unknown.jet:3:11
    |
  3 |     print(f(5))
    |           ^
 Why: a call is a value only when its function declares a result after the parameter list
 Fix: inside an arm, wrap the call in `{ … }`; otherwise put `f` on its own line, or declare it as `fn f(…) Type -> …`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0116
